page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head top centre. Marginal notes in the right margin, cropped and faint at the scan edge. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: Hoc autem dato juramento, & scuto haftaque accepta, prima militiæ tyrocinia, si esset opus, deponebant in obeundo agro Attico, & eum contra vim tuendo, vocabanturq; ex eo [illegible, ~3 letters]ἀπίπολοι [?], quasi circuitores: domi vero & suis rebus ipsi præerant sine tutore, & in conciones ventitabant, & spectandis ludis theatra inibant, donec ad munera alia pacis & belli maturescerent. Hæc soboles fuit domi perpetuò succrescens, & in locum decedentium novos cives indigenas civitati sufficiens. Præter quos alii quoque nonnunquam civium numerum auxere, qui re aliquâ suadente civitatis jure donabantur. [illegible, ~4 letters]Sic quippe Clisthenes post ejectos Pisistratidas, exhaustâ variis casibus civitate, ut frequentiam ejus reficeret, & simul partes suas contra æmulos firmaret, non solum peregrinos, sed & servos inquilinos, ut ait Aristoteles, in civitatem ad-scripsit. [illegible, ~3 letters]Similiter Platæenses extorres, patriâ eorum denuò à Thebanis eversa, populus universus benevolentiæ affectu motus, referente Hippocrate, civitate donavit, & adoptivos cives fecit, singulisque populum ac tribum assignavit, ut est apud Demosthenem contra Neæ-ram: quod quidem accidisse Diodorus ostendit archonte Athenis Socratide, [illegible, ~3 letters]anno

page.notes: The Greek word after "ex eo" is printed in Greek letters and is partly blurred; my reading (ἐπίπολοι, "circuitores") is doubtful and marked [?]. The right-margin notes are cut off at the scan edge and are not legible; the placeholders show where they stand. Faint marks at the left edge are show-through from the facing page and are omitted. A faint "E3" at the far lower right is outside the text and was not transcribed. The catchword "anno" is the start of the next page's text, as printed.
